summary: Rewrites AccountTrigger to count contacts per account with a query inside the loop over Trigger.new.

components.name: AccountTrigger
components.reason: SOQL per record hits the 100-query limit on bulk loads.

findings.message: SOQL inside a loop over Trigger.new: a data load of more than 100 accounts throws System.LimitException.
findings.fix: Query once before the loop: SELECT AccountId, COUNT(Id) FROM Contact WHERE AccountId IN :Trigger.newMap.keySet() GROUP BY AccountId, then read counts from a Map. Also move the logic into AccountService.
